canopy_headroom.definition: max(0, context-specific target canopy percent - observed canopy percent)
canopy_headroom.meaning: potential increase in canopy, not probability of suitability or plantable hectares
target_requirements: matching canopy definition and spatial support
canopy_headroom.no_headroom: no additional canopy under this scenario; does not establish agroforestry infeasibility

holds.finding: Your note is supported: this study estimates maximum tree cover compatible with maintaining agricultural yields. The pooled 27% (SD 16%) covers both cropping and grazing systems. It cannot be used as a cropland-only universal ceiling.
holds.recommendation: Approve the corrected summary as retained design evidence; keep the pooled value out of executable generic T4. Develop biome × farming-system canopy headroom using the source’s disaggregated values.

holds.finding: This source explicitly targets Kenyan cropland below 10% existing tree cover to align with a national policy target. Areas above 10% are not thereby unsuitable for agroforestry.
holds.recommendation: Approve the corrected policy-targeting interpretation as retained context evidence. Do not restore a generic ≤10% suitability mask. Any future Kenya targeting scenario requires explicit scope and policy-date validation.

holds.finding: The abstract and methods describe a nutrient-availability component of agroforestry land suitability in the Genale sub-basin. Policy relevance is an intended use, not the basis of the pH classes. However pH 8.2 falls in Low (>8), Medium (8–8.3), and High (7.4–8.4). The High class also prints a reversed interval (6.5–5.6).
holds.recommendation: Keep held for table ambiguity. Retain the record and exact classes; do not infer corrected bounds or reuse 6.6–7.3 as a global optimum. Resolution requires a verified correction or independent, applicable evidence.
